name: Alex G
discourse_profile: Giannascoli describes himself as a producer more than a singer-songwriter, treating GarageBand and the laptop as his primary instruments — tools for pitch-shifting, layering, and textural manipulation rather than just capture. His songwriting is aggressively intuitive: 'I just go off of intuition. The words that come into my head are what I put down,' and he deliberately avoids music theory to preserve the gut-level judgment of 'does it sound good?' He aligns his approach with Impressionism over realism — giving the listener a scene rather than a statement, using Sherwood Anderson's method of blowing single human traits out of proportion to create characters that are technically autobiographical but emotionally distorted. His governing principle is sustained self-engagement: 'the whole time I'm just trying to keep myself feeling something,' scrapping or reworking material that fails to provoke a reaction. His prolific early Bandcamp output established a practice of treating recording as continuous private activity rather than event, and his film scoring work extends the same logic — atmosphere and intimacy over narrative legibility, giving 'this thin tip of the iceberg, and hopefully the listener can pick up that there is something under the surface.'
